filterNotes: Dropped 1 Slither incorrect-exp (High) + 9 divide-before-multiply (Med) + 1 too-many-digits: all in lib/openzeppelin-contracts/contracts/utils/math/Math.sol (out-of-scope dependency, known-good library, root cause OOS).
Dropped Slither/Aderyn missing-zero-check (setMigrator/setPauser/state-var-without-checks): owner-config QA, suppressed per filter policy.

Dropped all 39 Semgrep findings: every result is INFO severity (ownable2step, non-payable-constructor, use-custom-error, prefix-increment, short-revert-string, nested-if, unnecessary-checked-arith) — QA/style only, no vulnerability.

Dropped Aderyn QA-class: Centralization Risk (owner-trust, Law 3), PUSH0 Opcode, Modifier Invoked Only Once (#126), Unspecific Solidity Pragma, Costly operations inside loop (#458, kept as Slither calls-loop instead).
KEPT all 11 Slither timestamp findings normalized into one entry per suite policy (time-driven protocol; not auto-dropped).

Single-function reentrancy is guarded by nonReentrant on every state-changing entry; findings retained at honest low/medium for the cross-function / state-after-external-call lens the regression brief requested around the new relinquishPrincipal call.

findings.description: External call R = _routeExit(token, P, false) at #405 reaches strategy.relinquishPrincipal(token,amount) (#703) / strategy.withdraw (#709); state migrationInfo[token] (#426) and yieldStrategy[token]=address(0) (#419) are written AFTER the external call. yieldStrategy/migrationInfo are read by _routeExit, withdrawDisabled, rescueERC20, setYieldStrategy, pendingReward — cross-function reentrancy surface. Function carries nonReentrant so single-fn re-entry is blocked; flagged for the strategy-callback / CEI lens (story-007).

External call _routeExit(token,staked,false) at #216 reaches strategy.relinquishPrincipal (#703) / strategy.withdraw (#709), then strategy.deposit (#233); yieldStrategy[token]=strategy is written AFTER at #223. yieldStrategy is cross-function reentrant (read by _routeExit/rescueERC20/withdrawDisabled). nonReentrant present; the old strategy is fully trusted-by-owner but the new external relinquishPrincipal call makes the ordering load-bearing (story-006/007).

External calls _settle->phUSD.mint (#651) and _routeDeposit->strategy.deposit (#679) precede writes to pool.totalStaked (#270), user.amount (#269), user.rewardDebt (#271). poolInfo/userInfo are cross-function reentrant (pendingReward, _updatePool). Guarded by nonReentrant; included for completeness of the external-call-then-write inventory.

External calls _settle->phUSD.mint (#651) and _routeDeposit->strategy.deposit (#679) precede writes to pool.totalStaked (#551), info.amount (#550), info.rewardDebt (#552). Same cross-function reentrancy surface as stake; onlyMigrator + nonReentrant. Included for completeness.

Aderyn HIGH: state changed after external call — migrationInfo[token]={active:true,realized:R,...} (#426) and yieldStrategy[token]=address(0) (#419) set after _routeExit external realization (#405, reaching relinquishPrincipal #703 / withdraw #709). Corroborates SLITHER-001 (raises confidence). Re-check that the post-exit principalOf==0 require (#410-413) and snapshot writes cannot be subverted by a malicious-strategy callback before active flips; strategy is owner-wired/trusted but the call is new (story-007).

YieldStrategySet event emitted at #237 after external calls _routeExit (#216, relinquishPrincipal #703 / withdraw #709) and strategy.deposit (#233). Event-ordering only; informational corroboration of the external-call surface in the changed setYieldStrategy path.

Return values ignored: strategy.deposit(token,idleBalance,address(this)) at #233 (credited principal discarded — idle-sweep does not reconcile booked-vs-swept, relevant to buffer/principal accounting the brief flagged); _stakers add/remove bool ignored at #272, #292, #332, #495, #553 (benign, set membership is idempotent). The #233 deposit-return drop is the noteworthy one: a market strategy that haircuts the swept idle balance would silently under-custody without the contract noticing.

Local `total` (#457) declared without explicit initialization; defaults to 0 and is summed in the loop then transferred (#466). Benign (0-default is intended) — flagged by both Slither and Aderyn (Aderyn instance lands in StableStakerMigrator.sol:75, out of this file's scope).

Block-timestamp dependence (11 sites): reward accrual elapsed = block.timestamp - lastRewardTime (#638), pendingReward projection (#565-566), _updatePool guard (#631), and migrationInfo.active comparisons. KEPT per suite policy — this is a time-driven emission protocol so timestamp logic is load-bearing, not informational; dedup/severity-classifier to decide fate. Note #701 (t.balanceOf(this) >= amount, the buffer-withdrawal guard) is mis-tagged by Slither as a timestamp comparison — it is a balance check in the new relinquishPrincipal buffer path, worth a manual look.
